Baluddin

Overview

Baluddin collects Joon antiquities. Sahilia’s theft from his house gives Zak a way to arrange a meeting with him. He says he recognised At-Zako as a living Joon before imperial scholars took the young man away. Later he was called to identify those same scholars’ mutilated bodies, a discovery that redirects the investigation toward necromancy. [1, 2]

Sahilia’s cache and the Joon collector

Sahilia supplies the next lead through her own theft. Antiquities she stole from Baluddin remain hidden near the city, and Zak recovers them to arrange a meeting. Khatul and Brother Blacksmith help choose the secluded trading place, keeping strangers away from the Shelter. Baluddin admits recognising At-Zako as a living Joon and wanting to keep him in his own house. Imperial scholars took the young man away. Later, Taivo summoned the collector to identify those scholars’ mutilated bodies. The missing youth’s trail now leads to the necromancers rather than a living prisoner whom Zak can simply rescue. [1, 3, 4, 2, 5, 6, 7]
